data.narrative:
PAVE Space is a seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Julie Böhning and Jérémy Marciacq, both alumni of the Gruyère Space Program at EPFL. The company has raised $40M to date. The comparable universe consists of 6 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Valuation analysis was conducted using stage-progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. This method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage transitions, yielding $100M from the $40M raised proxy. Peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables in the narrow peer set; while 14 total space and aerospace peers exist, fewer than three met stage and valuation-tier filters. Public-comp anchoring via the 27.4x median P/S multiple across the five public tickers was inapplicable absent the target's revenue disclosure, standard for private companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $85M to $115M, with $100M as the central point estimate. Key uncertainties include absence of revenue-based valuation signals, limited seed-stage precedent within the immediate peer set, and the wide dispersion typical of early-stage space ventures. A revenue disclosure would enable P/S-based triangulation and strengthen conviction in the range.
